question: Who was the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnam Malleswari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Karnam Malleswari **is a former woman weightlifter from India.
 
• She was born on June 1, 1975, and belongs to Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Her first achievement was at Weightlifting Nationals (senior)&am
